rules.title: DB types: coerce bigint to number in serializers
rules.summary: The pg driver returns bigint as string; always coerce in the serializer with Number() so it never leaks to API consumers.

enforcement.what: Inline-snapshot tests lock response shapes; a stringified number in the diff means the coercion was forgotten.

rules.title: RQ keys: only via centralized factories
rules.summary: All useQuery/useMutation keys must come from `apps/web/src/shared/lib/queryKeys.ts` factories (finykKeys, nutritionKeys, …); secrets must be hashed via hashToken() before use in a key.

enforcement.what: Reviewer checks for inline `["finyk", …]`-style key arrays; factories provide types so typos break the build.

rules.title: API contract: server response shape ↔ api-client types ↔ test
rules.summary: Changing a JSON response shape in apps/server/src/modules/* requires three coordinated edits in the same PR: handler, packages/api-client types, and the inline-snapshot test.

enforcement.what: Snapshot drift catches missing handler/test sync.
PR reviewer checks api-client types match the response shape.

rules.title: SQL migrations: sequential, no gaps, two-phase for DROP
rules.summary: Files in apps/server/src/migrations/ use NNN_description.sql (no gaps). Renaming/removing a column requires two phases deployed separately so Railway pre-deploy never breaks the running app.

enforcement.what: Migration lint job (AGENTS rule #4) checks numbering and forbids same-PR DROP+code change.

rules.title: Conventional Commits: explicit scope enum
rules.summary: Commit format <type>(<scope>): <subject>; scope must come from the registered enum (web, server, mobile, …, ci, docs, root). Do not invent new scopes.

enforcement.what: commitlint validates type + scope-enum on every PR.

rules.title: No force push to main/master
rules.summary: `--force-with-lease` on feature branches is OK; force pushes to main/master are forbidden.

enforcement.what: GitHub branch-protection on main/master disables force pushes.

rules.title: Pre-commit hooks via Husky — do not skip
rules.summary: `--no-verify` is forbidden; if a hook is broken, fix the hook in the same PR rather than bypassing it.

enforcement.what: Convention; reviewer rejects PRs whose commits clearly skipped hooks (Prettier/ESLint drift in committed files).

rules.title: Tailwind colour-opacity steps must be on the registered scale
rules.summary: Tailwind only emits `<color>/<N>` for N in the registered opacity scale (0, 5, 8, 10, 15, 20, …, 100). Any other step (/7, /9, /12, /18) is silently dropped — the design system enforces this via ESLint.

rules.title: Saturated brand fills behind text-white must use the -strong companion
rules.summary: Saturated brand colours regress to ~2.4–2.8:1 contrast against white. Use `bg-{family}-strong` (or `bg-{family}/N` soft wash with `text-{family}-strong`) for any text-on-fill context.

rules.title: Lifecycle markers — every file/doc declares its status
rules.summary: Code files use JSDoc lifecycle tags (@scaffolded / @experimental / @deprecated); docs use a `> **Status:** <state>` badge under the freshness marker. `pnpm dead-code:files` honours @scaffolded — never delete a scaffolded file just because it has zero importers.

enforcement.what: Every doc with a freshness marker must carry a Status: badge.

rules.title: No arbitrary hex colors in className
rules.summary: Tailwind arbitrary values like `bg-[#fff]` bypass the design-tokens preset and module-accent system. Add new shades to `packages/design-tokens/tailwind-preset.js` (with -soft / -strong companions per HR-9).

rules.title: Module-accent containment — no foreign accents inside a module subtree
rules.summary: Each module (finyk, fizruk, nutrition, routine) owns one accent family; never use another module's accent inside its subtree. "One accent = one module."

rules.title: No raw-palette light/dark className pairs
rules.summary: Paired `bg-amber-500/10 dark:bg-amber-500/15` etc. must use semantic replacements (`bg-{family}-soft`, `border-{module}-soft-border`, …) backed by `--c-{family}-soft*` CSS variables.

rules.title: Visible focus indicators must use focus-visible:, not focus:
rules.summary: Focus rings use the `focus-visible:` Tailwind variant so they only render for keyboard navigation, not after every mouse click. `focus:` paired with a colour utility is forbidden on web.

rules.title: Read governance before coding; update docs alongside code
rules.summary: Before implementing: read the relevant playbook + matching hard rules + freshness headers of cited docs. Before opening the PR: update api-client types, design-system docs, playbooks, and freshness headers — docs are part of the change set, not a follow-up.

enforcement.what: Validates Status badges + freshness markers stay paired.
`--check-coverage` fails if a non-excluded .md lacks a freshness header.
PR template's `Pre-flight (Hard Rule #15)` checklist (`Read AGENTS.md / playbook / freshness headers`).
